Q6064.reason: If the tenant believed the lease still bound him, he acknowledged the landowner's title, so his possession was not hostile and the 20-year period never ran; stopping rent alone does not make possession adverse, and the team note's reasoning is wrong.

Q8442.reason: Austin's Province of Jurisprudence Determined explicitly separates general jurisprudence from particular jurisprudence; the team note attributing it to Holland is incorrect.
